what: When the top edge of a photo or video cell touches the screen center, it pauses .1s, then a flat band attached to the top edge moves down as the cell opens (polygon clip, 1.6s expo.inOut). Over the same time the inner image settles from 1.3x to its own size. Once only

options.ease: Curve, default expo.inOut — can also be written like ‹0.87,0,0.13,1›
options.from: Initial scale of the inner image, default 1.3
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Inner image to sink (first child if none)

from.where: index.html .g-story__media·.g-grid__item·.g-art__media (story photo and pink video grid, ClipIn)
